{"reason":"Add a market-signal-mismatch branch labeled demand-forecast-error. Five listed unknown failures have mismatch=#t and total 854,000, so accuracy should rise above 0.708 and recovered amount above 3,161,000, while preserving supplier-delay classifications and improving recovery-rate above 0.607.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.1))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
